title: Interview: John Lennon for Newsweek | 1980
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono were interviewed by Newsweek reporter Barbara Graustark on 8 September 1980.

The interview took place at the Hit Factory, where the couple were recording the Double Fantasy album.

Graustark attended several of the album sessions, and also interviewed Lennon and Ono at the Dakota Building on 16 September, and at the Hit Factory on 17 September. The interview appeared in the 29 September 1980 issue of Newsweek, which went on sale on 22 September.
